label: Eventing Function
type: the core Eventing primitive - a JavaScript handler reacting to KV mutations, with its own lifecycle, bindings, and scope
note: Headline finding of round 8: Eventing needs no new structural layer the existing vocabulary can't express - no Sync-Gateway-style inversion, no Java-SDK-transactions-style concurrency primitive. Every 'unsupported feature' (no global state, no asynchrony beyond Timers, no browser extensions) resolves back to an existing Eventing construct rather than needing a new one. See reconciliation.md round 8.
